notes.title: Toy Tactics 1.1A: Release Notes
notes.content:
We're excited to bring you the latest update for Toy Tactics! This patch addresses several key issues and introduces important fixes to improve your gameplay experience. We’ve been listening closely to your feedback and have worked hard to make sure everything runs smoother than ever. Below is a list of the most significant changes in this update:

Fixes and Changes:

 All achievements are now working.
 Polish and Czech special characters have been fixed.
 Drawing bugs and missing orders have been resolved.
 Minor errors and access problems have been addressed.
 Online countdown issues have been fixed.
 Emote selection is now supported when using a controller.
 Skeleton altar now works for allies in co-op.


We hope these improvements enhance your experience with Toy Tactics. As always, we appreciate your continued support and feedback. Stay tuned for more updates, and don't hesitate to let us know if you encounter any other issues or have suggestions for future improvements. Keep those strategies sharp and enjoy the game!

notes.title: Final Update Before Launch
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/9354bcdbebb928a7903e1d55216b62e4b72038c4.png
As we approach the official release, we’re excited to announce that everything is now finalized. Get ready to sharpen your skills, because the upcoming game modes available at launch will be Multiplayer Versus (1vs1) and Multiplayer Cooperative (1+1 vs AI).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/38eae21483370cff79208b1b920190ce78d61738.png

    What’s New in This Update:
        Touchscreen Support: You can now enjoy full touchscreen functionality.
        Scene Updates & Balancing: Multiple scenes have been updated and rebalanced for better gameplay.
        Skirmish Mode Warning: A new alert will notify you if you attempt to start Skirmish mode without any spells equipped.
        Unit Videos in Army Camp: Watch your units in action with new videos available in the army camp.
        Boss Improvements: Fixed boss attack cancellations and rebalanced their difficulty for a more engaging challenge.
        Customization: Your selected colors are now saved automatically.
        Visual Upgrades: Decals have been replaced with a new system, and trails and particle render orders have been refined.
        Enhanced performance: Improvements to ensure smoother gameplay and faster load times.
        Environmental Updates: Removed underwater vegetation to enhance performance.
        Cinematic Additions:
                Visualize army cinematics directly from the camp.
                Enjoy the new boss ending cinematics, everytime you defeat any boss.		
        Gameplay Tweaks:
                Karts now halt when captured by enemies.
                Chest retrieval mechanics have been revised for specific scenarios.
                Improved arrow sticking for more realistic interactions.
                Reworked pathfinding costs for navigating through and around buildings, both intact and destroyed.
        Bug Fixes:
                Various achievements have been corrected.
                Spells on top of buildings are now functioning as intended.
                Resolved issues with specific spells, including Trojan Horse, Galleon, and Barrels.
                Relic fixes, including adjustments to Ghost Area, Wolf Cloak, and Ancilia.
        Audio & Visual Enhancements:
                Credits audio now respects master volume settings.
                Simplified Fireflight light effects for better performance.
                Campaign markers have been resized and modified for improved clarity.
This will likely be the final update before the official launch, so dive in and explore these changes as you prepare for the big day!

notes.title: Toy Tactics Character Design
notes.content:
Treasure hunts and high seas in Toy Tactics

Hello again, Commanders! We are back today with more amazing info and illustrations of one of our favorite bosses: Bonney and Read. Hoist your sails and grab your parrots, because these Pirates take no prisoners!
Aye, Captain! As with our Kitsune Boss, we began by searching for inspiration in Pirate history, to be very precise. The Age of Piracy lasted around 200 years, so there are many cool legends to choose from. 
However, since we wanted to make a dual boss, we decided on two historical female pirates: Anne Bonney and Mary Read.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/5ee2b892f28b2ef1fd8fc96747ec6bf0b1ef33a5.png

These two were actual pirates! So we thought it would be really cool to fight both of them at once, as they were seen together a lot of the time. They even sailed on the same ship. Also, we think they are cool.

From Concept to Gameplay and Back

Once the initial ideas were settled, our amazing concept artist Ana first drafted a few different designs to see what could be done with Bonney and Read. Look at this:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/dc76cb1f70db1ffc93c8a4967e6a95546db4d9df.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/fcace8e6ea749be6721f564d18f5b712dc9f0eff.png

Ana tried out different looks for Bonney, ranging from very ragged to formal to more feminine. In the beginning, you want to try out a lot of different things to see what could work and what doesn't. It’s not uncommon to draw dozens and dozens of concepts to arrive at the single perfect one.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/79bd2852f7ee4604935756ae5aa30d1251ee8436.png

But as much as you can work on the overall look, you need to know a few gameplay things before finalizing it. For example, what kind of weapons will they carry? How big will they be? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/27e39824f7a8965ad02ee7b83eabbfb7509a3788.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/2e6f469cc61a733e6100b2aa1f1730893839f6e0.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/0d44274416f6b9d68940d4988a307ae47edc8f27.png

The concept artist must work together with our game designer to hammer out some of these details; only then can we get to the final concept.

The Devil is in the Details

Ana, a huge fan of pirates, said: “I’ve been in love with pirates since I was twelve or thirteen. I just love the freedom and authenticity they exude.” So it was no surprise that she was careful with her pirate designs.
The Age of Piracy lasted about 200 years all over the Caribbean, so when designing Bonney and Read, she had to ensure the clothing, weapons, and look were not separated by decades. For their clothing and weapons, we focused mostly on the last 50 to 80 years of the Age. “You try to be as authentic as possible,” she says, and avoid anachronisms. At least the too-obvious ones. It’s still a fantasy toy boss, though, so some latitude is good.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/9320ac6416c5dd5ac42162ab843d832f180296d6.png

The Final Character

In the end, they look like this:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/24914dcde8f80facaefcd8f7642896e4a35aba42.png

Fear them, for they have the power of the sea on their side! I personally love their weapons: jewelry swords and a shark cannon. Whatever you do, do it with style, argh!
If you want to be a Pirate, you can control them or play against them right now in the Early Access of Toy Tactics! 😁 

Follow us on Steam for more in-depth content about our strategy puzzle RTS Toy Tactics. Once again, thanks for reading, Commanders!

notes.title: Age of the Samurai
notes.content:
Hello, Commanders! Today, we will be showing you some cool behind-the-scenes content: the first finished conceptual piece for Kyoukai’s Boss, Kitsune. This is the first post introducing the character design in a series planned before the release, so stick around.

First step: Do some research

Like Sun Tzu probably said: know thy enemy. In this case, know thy samurais. Our amazing conceptual artist, Ana Andrés, did a ton of research into Japan’s Samurai era. Turns out, there were a lot of different kinds of samurai through the ages. They were very diverse in their aesthetic and even moral values, depending on the time and place. We decided to combine features which evoked the martial and clothing aesthetics of ancient Japan, along with some spiritual and folklore-related attributes. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/90d5023ebf6ae010e05268daf2b169b2bd08bc1a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/14946d20fa63327d2d798181f09421768e736f8f.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/663a62e7e38186abb4c8fd4567bb88e86268ad1a.png

Second step: Decide what you want from the concept

After doing the research, Ana decided which part to implement in the design. “We wanted the humble aesthetics of walk-in-the-night point of the samurai, so she has a straw cape. Japan is a very rainy country, so they used this kind of clothing to protect from the rain.”

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/5130288751e487e8b7c064339a085f4ed2bab70e.png

“We also wanted the regal part of the Samurai,” Ana continued.

This was a little harder to do, since the Kyoukai faction already has a lot of the very obvious thing to add: the amazing samurai armor. So we went with a different aesthetic, more feudal but also very rich: The Kimono.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/0918803ad96b1e8492ca32ae2cd2c89cd61c963e.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/a9b72d985408a07917d91b453b231c6d266e8509.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/0c0c9d473072ba4ebf797a42a30f210dfbaa4862.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/5623794ec1b4667432f79080b88d62d1375f6a07.png

Third step: Connect the dots

A very important part of any character design is a sense of belonging. We wanted to connect our amazing Kitsune Boss as much as possible to the rest of the Kyoukai faction, without losing her unique characteristics. She is a boss, so she obviously needs to stand out, and yet she needs to still feel like part of the rest of her army.

To accomplish this, we added some important details: the kimono is a very warm pink, a color that goes well with Kyoukai’s purple. We also added sakura as a further reference to Japan. She wears a Kitsune mask as well, which is not only the Kyoukai’s representative icon, but also an important fox deity in the Land Where the Sun Rises. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/9198288150c4bd6d73c3fb38045132caa4d1b342.png

She is one of our favorite bosses, and we are very proud of her. This is how she looks in her final form. ⚔️

You can play against her right now in Toy Tactics on Steam Early Access! 😁

Follow us on Steam for more in-depth content about our strategy puzzle RTS Toy Tactics. Thanks for reading, commanders!

notes.title: PAX East 2024 and the latest from Toy Tactics
notes.content:
PAX East 2024 was amazing! It took place from March 21-24 and is the first physical event of the year that Toy Tactics attended.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/808a1ad0176b593c88db93464220b78498a44f24.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/a92b79313903f9e11d413bbfd7c02f55caff4b73.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/a6c0b131e771f51fe2b83d487b1b6f0a2ab5f3bc.jpg

We have always enjoyed being in these type of events but this year was very special: we had a solo booth for Toy Tactics where we received a lot of people of all ages, influencers and press, who enjoyed the game, gave us their feedback and as a thank you for stopping by, we gave away exclusive merch for them to take home a little bit of Toy Tactics. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/05f817b8ad054c2d2372131c075fe48bdc564d1e.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/e3e3ce6829008d90b917ddd9c6fc94c5736c55c5.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/969611a3dec57a569556e2d5c456743383628890.jpg

Really, you don't know how grateful we are for your kind comments, to all the people who came back to play 3 or 4 times because they fell in love with Toy Tactics and for all the support during and after the event. All this love inspires us and we are more than excited to announce that Toy Tactics will be fully released on all consoles in Q3 of this year.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/3daba9201d1e79481c4c6d88eef8589bb6fa164c.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/5e798c3026d0c7b740e841105e7e6c55e0046aa0.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/f485b34538b7795668d78c2387c56282def0a312.jpg

The latest on Toy Tactics: 

Toy Tactics was launched in Early Access in March 2023, and since then, it has received significant content updates, resulting in over 25 hours of gameplay where you can enjoy:


 5 armies with their own abilities: Imperium (Roman Army), Pendragon (Medieval Army), Kyoukai (Samurai Army), Freebooters (Pirates Army), and Draugr (Skeleton Army: Before your enemies, now you can control them). 
 6 unique main units (infantry, archer, cavalry, heroe, king and queen) and unique secondary units (animals, siege units, and special units). More than 40 units available with different strengths and weaknesses.
 5 different spell trees: one per faction, with 16 spells related to the main abilities of the armies. 80 different spells to cast anywhere 💀
 5 relic collections: one collection per faction, 3 relics to choose for each unit to change passive abilities, 18 relics per army and 90 different relics.
 5 settings: including terrains, vegetation, trees and faction related contraptions.
 6 final bosses.
 5 playing modes:

 Campaign: 5 campaigns with more than 60 levels filled with primary and secondary objectives.
 Skirmish: 5 long levels to conquer and defend while producing new units.
 Puzzles: 6 campaigns with over 60 puzzles to solve, based on strategic concepts. 
 Mercenaries: 6 mercenary campaigns to beat while buying any unit within an initial budget. More than 60 challenges available.
 Creative: 10 different levels in which to create your own battles.



What to expect at full release? 

Toy Tactics will arrive on all consoles this year, featuring a mode highly anticipated by many: online multiplayer.

In the "multiplayer mode," you'll be able to engage in both competitive and cooperative experiences.

On one hand, there's "1vs1," which will be the "competitive mode" where you'll face off against another player, where strategic skill and quick decision-making will be paramount.

Looking for an intense battle? In 1vs1 battles, you can carefully build your army, select powerful relics and spells, and meticulously plan your tactics to emerge victorious.

On the other hand, in the "cooperative mode," you can have your ally, join forces, and combat the formidable opponent controlled by the AI. Together, you'll need to devise strategies, coordinate your actions, and efficiently produce units to survive the relentless siege.

All roads lead to Rome... and victory! ⚔️

Whether competing head-to-head or joining forces to defeat your enemy, with Toy Tactics' multiplayer modes, you'll experience exhilarating, prolonged skirmish battles full of excitement and challenge.

Stay tuned for more news and remember that Toy Tactics is currently in Early Access, so you can buy it right now and share your duels with us on Discord.

Attention, Tacticians!

I hope you're doing great, or at least feeling a bit better than us... lately, we've been feeling a bit dead inside, not because of anything bad, mind you, but because the entire studio has been working hard on Toy Tactics' latest update: The Awakening of the Undead 💀

We're eternally grateful for the support you've bestowed upon us. As you embark on this hair-raising adventure with us, keep a watchful eye for what's coming next in Toy Tactics. The Undead Army is rising, and the wobbliest strategy game around is about to get even spookier! 💀👻🎮

notes.title: ⚔️ Dev Diary #3 - Mercenary and Puzzle modes ⚔️
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/63d3393ab94182c73fa4dfa6fb05441c51562b5d.png
Hey Tacticians!

We're thrilled to share with you the latest progress on our project! During Strategy Festival Toy Tactics will be on discount, make sure to grab it while you can! Without further ado, let’s dive right in!

Here’s what to expect:

Changes to Mercenaries
New Challenges and Content

⚔️ MERCENARIES ⚔️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/337ac94a73a2964f5c9e040f14148b374d6b4356.jpg
WHAT'S THE BUZZ

With hard work paying off, we have some exciting news - face off against various groups of foes in quick and the many levels we have added. The twist? Here, you can purchase an array of units, powers, and even animals to aid you in your epic battles. But be careful not to over spend, as your budget is limited, which demands strategic choices for the players.

FEATURES

You’ll be able to explore diverse settings, each featuring unique situations for every faction, as well as a wide variety of units and powers to construct your ultimate lineup:

Roman
Medieval
Samurai
Pirate

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/a0071c8ccdc6bac9262d5bed5635c63d92809eab.jpg
Have you ever thought about using animals as bait? Now we have you covered with options like sheep, pigs, and even cows!

In this update, you can master the art of economic management and combat strategy as you progress through levels, facing the most hilarious and absurd situations imaginable.

WHY YOU SHOULD DIVE IN

The Mercenary mode is where the real magic happens. It's a complete departure from your usual campaign strategy, embracing trial and error with fast progression. All scenarios are unprecedentedly wacky, which we believe will keep you hooked for hours!

⚔️ CHALLENGES AND NEW CONTENT ⚔️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/df6d1335ca45ee5ce3a6d9ebb9c697d477b95d23.png

Several levels have been added corresponding to each playable faction. The creation of these levels has been based on the special feature/gift/power that the faction has.

 
Roman = Rebuild ruins/structures. 
Medieval = Leader fusions with specific units. 
Samurai = Stealth in the fog. 
Pirates = Ghost mode that allows you to go through things and the 
ability to be a little faster than other units in the water.

Basic levels have been balanced to get the best playable experience.
The UI of the challenge mode has been improved.
The progress of played/completed challenges is now saved.
Spells can now be used in challenge mode.
Fixed some bugs 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/ffbe8f7c4d1bf420e7698816a1fe8b024ce60a31.jpg
CHALLENGE MODE WHY?

With the challenge mode, your strategies will change with the new puzzle mode that is small, quick, and concise, and that you can repeat several times. You can use this knowledge in any other game mode, mainly in the campaign.

WHAT DOES IT ADD?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/c9d7ef2427d9ef5e733ea22d21c6436e1921ff5d.png
We know that it is important in a game of strategies and physics to be able to exploit them to get the most out of it. Good, quality content. With this mode, the game is approached differently than in the campaign.

LET'S TALK ABOUT LEVELS

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/176f8f196527155be7ed22b6046dc5c1f241b367.jpg
The challenge mode is divided into sections.

Basic
Roman
Medieval
Samurai
Pirates

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/77d819d9fa60e0fda7db6b5f7ee469aad095ba92.jpg
Basic or essentials is a kind of tutorial that teaches the strategies of each unit, their strengths and weaknesses.

Roman We added the Roman mechanics factor: the ability to rebuild ruined structures. Catapults, towers, and the faction's unique spells with the element of fire predominating in many of them.

Medieval: The ability to merge leaders with different types of units. The weapon or skills are changed by merging them with different types of units (archers, infantry, cavalry and heroes) and playing with spells in which the element of ice predominates.

Samurai: As good ninjas, stealth and fog is a very important part of this faction. Different challenges have been built, and new weapons called ‘mortar’ or ‘rock’ throwers are also added, where the predominant element is the poison.

Pirates:
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41327815/4ded91fa4a8c48deecfd92f956b00ccdc7d7bc21.jpg
Mechanically, you can become ghosts for a few seconds by dragging the formation while a pirate melody plays. Water, since they are pirates, is also an important element. There are even some armed crabs that will help you in your battles!

Don't miss out on this opportunity to experience Toy Tactics in a whole new light. Download the update now and let the strategic chaos begin!

notes.title: 0.753 live
notes.content:
Hi all! We are happy to announce you the new version of the game, with multiple bugs fixed an QOL improvements!

Gameplay

 Fixed giant chest in “The Lost Crusade” and enemy counter for a secondary objective.
 Fixed king attack range when joining with cavalry.
 Crows now work better in the main menu.
 Fixed the way enemy hero grabs chest in “The Lost Crusade”
 Fixed freezed build icons in Pier.
 Fixed random explosion when entering the first conquer area in Nimue’s Pond


Progression

 The default blessing for archers in the Roman campaign changed, it is now "Armour of Achilles".
 The blessing given on the 5th Roman level, hibernation, has changed, it is now "Arch of Apollo".


Level objectives

 Fixed "Defeat X units with your leader" objective has no counter.
 Fixed: A counter would be missing in the objective "Push 10 units into the void".


Performance

 Improved performance in all Pendragon levels
 HUD performance improved
 Small scripts optimizations
